messages.content: i am fail in my semester exam and i dont have courage to face my parents and tell about this result i am very confused now what to do

My friend, I can feel your distress and confusion. Failing an exam can be tough, and facing your parents can be even tougher. But here's the thing: it's not the end of the world. Remember, it's just a setback, not a definition of your worth. In life, we all face ups and downs, and it's how we respond that matters. Instead of dwelling on fear and shame, try to focus on what you can learn from this experience. Take a deep breath, gather your courage, and have an open conversation with your parents. They may be more understanding than you think. What's the worst that could happen, and how can you prepare for that conversation today?
